Content-Security-Policy header is not set. It restricts resources the page can load and prevents XSS attacks.

Referrer-Policy header is not set. It controls referrer header sharing and enhances privacy and security.

Feature-Policy header is not set. It allows enabling/disabling browser APIs and features for security. Not important if Permissions-Policy is set.. Feature-Policy header is not set but Permissions-Policy is set. That's enough.
Permissions-Policy header is not set. It allows enabling/disabling browser APIs and features for security.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set to '*' which allows any origin to access the resource. This can be a security risk.
X-XSS-Protection header is set but deprecated. Consider removing it and using Content-Security-Policy instead.
Server header is set to 'cloudflare'. It is better not to reveal used technologies.
